_description: Grounded multi-turn chat query-rewrite eval (Surface A, docs/specs/grounded-agentic-chat.md §9.1). Each case is a conversation HISTORY + a FOLLOW-UP whose referents the control-layer rewrite must resolve; the score is gold-chunk recall@k of hybrid_search on the REWRITTEN query (retrieval-isolated — no rerank/LLM in the inner metric). This measures the A-1.5 follow-up-resolution gap.
_doc_note: Source documents stay LOCAL (tests/eval-data/README.md); only this case set ships. `relevant_chunk_ids` are GOLD chunks resolved LIVE 2026-06-04 against THIS reference vault (CCNA SRWE modules, NIST SP 800-207, and the CR350 French security course incl. the Cours 8/9/10/11/12 decks ingested 2026-06-04). Re-resolve against your own index if your vault differs — chunk_ids are content-addressed, so a re-parse churns them (the 2026-06-01 seed gold had already drifted by 2026-06-04).
_metric: mean_recall = mean over cases of gold_chunk_recall(hybrid_search(rewritten_query)[:k], relevant_chunk_ids, k). A case < 1.0 means the rewrite failed to surface a gold chunk for that follow-up.
_scope_note: This eval measures REFERENT RESOLUTION / chunk SURFACING (retrieval-isolated), NOT answer correctness: it scores whether the rewritten follow-up retrieves the gold chunk, never whether a composed answer would be right. Some gold chunks are referent-bearing-but-not-the-direct-answer (fr-cours8's gold is a logging-definitions chunk for 'comment les gérer'; fr-cours11's is the email-threats table for 'comment les filtrer') — valid for the resolution metric, but a 1.0 here does NOT prove answer accuracy (that is the /ask HARD-gate eval's job). The cross-lingual case (xling-ckc) deliberately pins a FRENCH gold chunk (#e5cd668a52) so an EN follow-up genuinely tests EN-query→FR-chunk retrieval.
_k_note: k=20 (NOT the seed's lenient k=50). Each case is TWO-SIDED verified with scripts/chat_eval_author.py: at k=20 the IDEAL standalone query retrieves the gold (with rank margin) while the RAW follow-up (referents unresolved) MISSES it — so recall@20 actually measures the rewrite's referent resolution, not the dense arm's near-total recall@50. The model's rewrite is scored against that gap.

_baseline_2026_06_04._note: rewrite_followup/v1 on the Qwen3.5-4B orchestrator; embedder pinned (CO_RESIDENCE_MODE=manual). All 10 cases recall=1.0, byte-stable across N=3 — the current rewrite resolves every follow-up's referent (pronoun / possessive / elliptical / cross-deck / cross-lingual / multi-turn topic-return) well enough to surface the gold within k=20. This 1.0 is DISCRIMINATING, not lenient: every case is two-sided-verified so the RAW unresolved follow-up MISSES its gold at k=20 — a rewrite regression that drops a referent falls toward the raw and lowers recall. Gold re-resolved live 2026-06-04 (the 2026-06-01 seed gold had drifted after a re-process; 3 initially-overfit gold sub-chunks were re-resolved to the chunks the model's NATURAL rewrite retrieves, not my term-loaded ideal — the verify-with-the-eval's-own-path lesson).
